title: Warm Fatty Algerian Chickpeas Tagine
description: A comforting Algerian one-pot stew featuring chickpeas in a rich, creamy sauce. Serve with couscous or pita bread for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the fajita seasoning and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the chickpeas, diced tomatoes, beef broth, and cayenne pepper. Bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the flavors have melded together and the sauce has thickened slightly, about 20 minutes.
Stir in the heavy cream and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Stir in the chopped parsley and cook for 1 minute, or until wilted.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Cover and refrigerate or freeze for later use, if desired.
